notes.title: Balance improvements and more
notes.content:
This update includes:

[list]
[*] Increased XP for the levels and some badges, extra XP for Night levels, meaning the game is now easier and less grinding is needed for these who had to grind
[*] Improved interfaces and controls, including wave hints, tower sell confirmation, proper right mouse button use, build site highllighting etc.
[*] Bug fixes, including reduced loading time, crash on summoned units info and othrs.
[/list]

Merry Christmas and happy New Year! 🎄

notes.title: Update based on players' reviews
notes.content:
Based on the reviews and discussions, we made the following changes:

- [b]The game balance is tweaked[/b] - the missions 1-13 are easier and you gain more XP
- Evilopedia is now accessible from within the game
- ESC button is used for more cancel/close actions
- Hotkey tooltips are added to the in-game buttons
- The stats of towers and enemies are now displayed correctly
- Some bug fixes

Thanks for your feedback!
